source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The comm port marks BrowserProcess and 14 window-actor declarations with safeForUntrustedWebProcess: true, then passes the declaration objects to ActorManagerParent. It does not change a preference or the actor handlers. The accepted source later renames Pdfjs to PdfJs and makes the ContextMenu assignment conditional. These are checked registration fields; the upstream enforcement and handler security contracts were not paired.
title: MailGlue passes explicit untrusted-process opt-ins with its actor declarations
